title: Protein Supplements for Older Adults
subtitle: Evidence, dosing, safety, interactions, and practical considerations for protein supplements for older adults.
evidence_strength: Moderate evidence from clinical trials and systematic reviews supports the use of protein supplements combined with exercise to improve muscle mass and function in older adults. Some uncertainty remains regarding optimal dosing, long-term outcomes, and specific effects in subpopulations such as those with chronic illness or impaired kidney function.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
